title: THE FLAYED WARDROBE // DREADFORT CELLARS
narrative: Deep in the granite underbelly of the Dreadfort, behind a secret revolving slab of slate, lay Roose Bolton's true ancestral collection. Hanging on polished silver hooks were forty-two complete human skin suits, tanned paper-thin with lavender oil and salt, each bearing the face of a historical Bolton lord from the Age of Heroes. A glass vial of leech blood rested on a velvet pedestal beside an ancient razor of Valyrian steel. A chill ran down the spy's spine as he realized the horrifying truth: Roose Bolton was not a man, but an immortal skin-stealer who had ruled the Dreadfort for three millennia by peeling and wearing the faces of his own bastard sons.

options.text: Roose Bolton: Peel off his own face in the solar to reveal the void.
Wyman Manderly: Deploy the heavy spear phalanx against the retreating Freys.
Mance Rayder: Fight through the blizzard during the Winterfell escape.
The Flayed Man: Watch the gates of Winterfell fall in the liberation.
